record.paper_title: Properly Coloured Cycles and Paths: Results and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Characterization of complete graphs with properly coloured Hamilton cycles
record.original_question: For a fixed number of colours c ≥ 3, find a characterization of those c-edge-coloured complete graphs K_n^c that contain a properly coloured Hamilton cycle.

evidence.quote: In fact, no characterization of Kc_n with a PC Hamilton cycle is known for any fixed c ≥ 3 and it is a very interesting problem to obtain such a characterization.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let c ≥ 3 be a fixed integer. A c-edge-coloured complete graph K_n^c is the complete graph on n vertices in which each edge is assigned one of c colours (with no restriction on how often each colour is used). A Hamilton cycle in K_n^c is called properly coloured if every pair of consecutive edges along the cycle has distinct colours.

Problem: Provide a structural characterization (necessary and sufficient conditions, checkable in polynomial time if possible) of those c-edge-coloured complete graphs K_n^c that contain a properly coloured Hamilton cycle.
artifact.status_search_result: A characterization of edge-coloured complete graphs containing a properly coloured Hamilton path was obtained by Feng, Giesen, Guo, Gutin, Jensen, and Rafiey (confirming a Bang-Jensen–Gutin conjecture), but for properly coloured Hamilton cycles in K_n^c with fixed c ≥ 3, no such characterization is known. Recent literature offers only sufficient conditions (e.g., asymptotic versions of the Bollobás–Erdős conjecture) and partial results, with no characterization theorem reported.

status_evidence.title: Properly coloured Hamiltonian cycles in edge-coloured complete graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Sufficient condition (asymptotic Bollobás–Erdős) for PC Hamilton cycle; no characterization given.
status_evidence.claim: Only sufficient conditions are known for PC Hamilton cycles in edge-coloured complete graphs.

status_evidence.title: Characterization of edge-colored complete graphs with properly colored Hamilton paths
status_evidence.snippet: Characterization is given for the Hamilton path version, not cycle version.
status_evidence.claim: The path analogue is characterized; the cycle case for fixed c ≥ 3 remains without a characterization.
